zh-Hans: 与服务端 v0.9.4-pre5 一起发布
脱敏不再把 systemd 服务名（例如 getty@tty1.service）当成邮箱打码，邮箱照常打码
进程类发现（临时目录中的程序等）增加有效 UID 和用户名，服务端据此支持“暂停提醒”
en: Redaction no longer masks systemd unit names such as getty@tty1.service as email addresses; email addresses are still masked
Process findings (programs in temp directories and the like) carry the effective UID and user name, which the server uses to pause alerts
